pacing_notes: The joke plays out almost entirely in one sustained two-shot/reaction pairing rather than rapid cutting: a 4.2s setup shot, a long 6.7s reaction-heavy shot carrying the bulk of the story beat, then a shorter 3.9s shot for the sarcastic punchline delivery, before an abrupt 1.6s hard cut to the black title card ends the video immediately on the laugh line. Pacing is driven more by held reactions and dialogue timing than by cut frequency, with the only acceleration being the final snap-cut to the outro card denying any lingering reaction time.
